title: Finish Time of Tasks II
summary: Choose a root for the task tree. A leaf finishes in its baseTime. For a non-leaf, let earliest and latest be the minimum and maximum child finish times; its finish time is 2*latest-earliest+baseTime. Return the smallest root finish time over all root choices.
